# Noise Wipe

**Wipe › Organic** · v1.0.0 · 30 frames at 30 fps (12–72)

A ragged, noise-driven edge sweeps across the frame, like a torn or eroded border.

[Preview video](https://github.com/GTKottman/remotion-transitions/releases/download/media/noise-wipe@1.0.0.mp4)

## Where it is used

- Organic, handmade looks
- Documentary and nature edits
- Softer alternative to a linear wipe

## Use it

```tsx
import { linearTiming, TransitionSeries } from '@remotion/transitions';
import { toPresentation } from './src/core';
import noiseWipe from './transitions/03-wipe/organic/noise-wipe';

<TransitionSeries.Transition
  presentation={toPresentation(noiseWipe, { /* params */ })}
  timing={linearTiming({ durationInFrames: 30 })}
/>
```

Use `linearTiming`: the transition applies its own easing.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Range | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `direction` | enum | `"left"` | `left` · `right` · `up` · `down` | Direction the motion travels. |
| `roughness` | number | `0.12` | 0–0.4 | How far the edge wanders, as a fraction of the frame. |
| `seed` | integer | `1` | 0–9999 | Changes the random layout. |
